User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the AttendaVision system, either a student or a teacher.

role.description: The user's role in the system (e.g., student, teacher).

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: Represents an educational resource uploaded by a teacher.

classId.description: The ID of the class this resource belongs to.

description.description: A brief description of the resource.

fileUrl.description: The URL to the uploaded resource file.

topic.description: The topic or module this resource relates to.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the resource was created.

uploaderId.description: The user ID of the teacher who uploaded the resource.

downloadCount.description: How many times the resource has been downloaded.

Grievance.title: Grievance
Grievance.description: Represents a grievance or issue reported by a student.

studentId.description: The ID of the student who submitted the grievance.

classId.description: The ID of the class this grievance relates to (optional).

priority.description: The priority level of the grievance.

subject.description: A short subject line for the grievance.

description.description: A detailed description of the issue.

status.description: The current status of the grievance.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the grievance was submitted.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp when the grievance was last updated.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore structure prioritizes authorization independence and clarity for the AttendaVision app. User data is stored under `/users/{userId}` for simple ownership-based access control. Separate collections for roles (`/roles_teacher/{userId}`, `/roles_student/{userId}`) enable role-based access without custom claims, relying on document existence. QR codes, essential for student attendance, are stored in the `/qrcodes/{qrcodeId}` collection, including denormalized class membership data (`classId` and `members` map copied from class) to allow students to scan QR codes of all classes they are members of, and enforce secure `list` operations. Classes are stored under `/classes/{classId}`, each containing a `members` map for authorization, also, a `qrcodeId` field that references a document id in the `/qrcodes/{qrcodeId}` collection. A subcollection, `/classes/{classId}/resources/{resourceId}`, stores educational materials, with access controlled by class membership. Attendance records are stored in `/attendances/{attendanceId}`, with denormalized `userId`, `classId` and `timestamp` fields to facilitate efficient queries and reporting without complex joins. Finally, the `attendanceHistory` of a student is stored under `/users/{userId}/attendanceHistory/{attendanceHistoryId}`, with timestamp and classId to facilitate viewing personal attendance history.
